description:
Show whether YOUR company is connected to other companies in SpiderGate, which
companies they are, how many keys each shares, and — for keys your company owns — how many
requests each connected company sent through them. `group: null` means your company is not
connected; that is an answer, not an error. You see only your own group: no tool lists other
SpiderGate companies. Takes no brand argument: your company comes from your credential.

Connected keys are use only for you: you can use them, never change them (see
gate_subscriptions). Connecting, disconnecting and pairing codes are done by a human admin in the
dashboard; there is no tool for them, by design.
name: gate_group
